summary.en: A civil war continues in Myanmar: airstrikes in Rakhine, Kyauktaw and Mon states, re-arrested political prisoners, an outbreak in Karenni and record drug seizures stand out. The publication of photos of Suu Kyi and US talks with the junta-backed government in Tokyo show limited diplomatic activity, but violence and the humanitarian situation are decisive. Economic news such as coffee exports does not offset the grave security and humanitarian picture.

en: Airstrike in Kyauktaw and ongoing fear of further airstrikes (schools remain closed)
Re-arrest of 20 political prisoners who had been released
Record drug seizures and humanitarian needs due to the civil war
Limited diplomatic activity: US-Myanmar government talks and photos of Suu Kyi
No consensus between the junta and the resistance

summary.en: The period is dominated by the ongoing civil war: airstrikes with survivors needing aid, expanding military operations, forced recruitment, rearrests of released prisoners, and attacks on churches. Only minor economic items (honey and coffee trade with China) offset this, and foreign media coverage is mostly negative.

en: Airstrike in Kyauktaw leaves deadly toll and urgent humanitarian needs
Military operations expand and renewed assault on Ngapyi Island
Forced recruitment of ex-fighters for a militia; released prisoners rearrested

summary.en: Myanmar's news over the period reflects an ongoing armed conflict: clashes nearing Sittwe, aid workers relocating, junta resupply convoys, and a stalled peace framework. Economic and diplomatic items, such as the Thai gas talks and the China-Myanmar think-tank forum, are modest offsets.

en: Clashes approaching Sittwe prompt aid workers to relocate
Junta convoy resupplying military bases toward Myitkyina
Karenni peace framework contested; junta insists on NCA

summary.en: Ongoing armed conflict dominates the period, with martial law extended as fighting escalates in Kachin and shelling reported near the Karen and Mon junction. The approved phone call between Aung San Suu Kyi and her son and a renewed junta peace-talks invitation are modest positives, but they do not offset the fighting.

en: Martial law extended as fighting escalates in Kachin State
Ongoing artillery shelling near Karen and Mon States junction
Suu Kyi's first call with son in five years, a humanitarian gesture

summary.en: Domestic reporting describes ongoing junta airstrikes, fighting, forced conscription, abductions and killings of civilians, with tone far more negative than the world average. The only clearly positive items are Aung San Suu Kyi's first call with her son in five years and diplomatic talk of US contact, which do not offset the violence.

en: Junta airstrikes and fighting continue, including in Mon State and Ngapyi Island
Abductions for conscription and civilian executions reported by local media
Suu Kyi's first call with her son in five years, a humanitarian signal

summary.en: The period is dominated by ongoing armed conflict: junta air raids forcing school closures, civilian deaths in Karenni State, and reported ambushes and conscript abuses. Only minor positives appear, such as a hospital equipment donation, and the GDELT tone is strongly negative.

en: Junta air raids force school closures across Arakan townships
Karenni State reports 49 civilians killed in nine months
Resistance ambushes inflict heavy casualties on junta column

summary.en: The period was mostly routine: a few Myanmar-related items covered student exchanges, sanctions-evasion fuel reporting, and a report of Aung San Suu Kyi's first call with her sons in five years. The Indian drug-crackdown stories concern India, not Myanmar, so they do not count. The slightly negative tone and the sanctions story are offset by the family-contact report, leaving the score near a normal day.

en: Aung San Suu Kyi's first call with her sons in five years
Reuters and JPost reporting on sanctioned Iranian fuel imports
Routine cultural and student exchange coverage

summary.en: Myanmar's news flow is negative: power outages, about 10,000 garment workers facing layoffs, and reports that returnees were detained by the army, which Malaysia has asked Myanmar to explain. GDELT tone (-1.08) is more negative than the world average (-0.52), and the headlines describe ongoing hardship and conflict without any clear sign of recovery.

en: Around 10,000 garment workers in Yangon face mass layoffs
Reports of detained returnees; Malaysia seeks explanation from Myanmar
Power outages leave junta heat shelters unused in Mon State

summary.en: The period is dominated by ongoing armed conflict: deadly shelling in Sittwe, junta airstrikes in Rakhine and Karenni areas, and resistance groups rejecting peace talks. Humanitarian strain is severe, with an ASEAN aid mission and a Rohingya repatriation crisis as the only partial counterweights.

en: Deadly shelling in Sittwe and airstrike fears across Rakhine and Karenni
Resistance forces reject junta-led peace talks
Rohingya repatriation described as a humanitarian crisis

summary.en: Ongoing armed conflict dominates the period, with reported junta airstrikes killing civilians, naval clashes near Sittwe, rocket attacks in Loikaw, and a UN accusation of chemical munitions use. Limited positives, such as humanitarian missions and resistance cooperation talks, do not offset the widespread violence.

en: Junta airstrikes reportedly killing civilians in western Myanmar
Arakan Army naval strikes and Sittwe landing battles
UN accusation of chemical munitions use by junta

summary.en: Armed conflict dominated the period: heavy fighting near Sittwe displaced civilians across 70 villages, an airstrike on downtown Sittwe killed at least six, and fuel shortages spread. Diplomacy stalled, with an ASEAN envoy leaving without meeting Aung San Suu Kyi, while a few routine stories (festival, heat preparations) offered little relief.

en: Heavy fighting near Sittwe displaces civilians across 70 villages
Airstrike on downtown Sittwe kills at least six, wounds 37
ASEAN envoy leaves without meeting Suu Kyi; war on multiple fronts

summary.en: The period is dominated by ongoing civil-war violence: a junta airstrike hitting a high school, a renewed military offensive, fighting that displaced hundreds, and abductions and conscription abuses. The only diplomatic signal is an ASEAN envoy urging a peace plan, which does not offset the violence.

en: Junta airstrike hits high school in Maungdaw
Second junta offensive to retake Ponnagyun
Hundreds displaced as fighting escalates in Upper Myanmar

summary.en: Myanmar's civil war continues, with reports of airstrikes using large bombs on Karen areas, a months-long internet blackout in Arakan State, and a drone war described as among the world's most intense. Some signals are constructive: a foreign foundation offered to mediate peace, and the government moved to channel migrant remittances through official banks.

en: Airstrikes with 500-pound bombs on Karen areas, affecting Thai border communities
Months-long internet blackout in Arakan State raising residents' costs
Offer to mediate peace process in the civil war

summary.en: The period is mostly routine coverage: a state-media feature on an elephant's birthday, a new fish species study, and ASEAN and military-cooperation news. Negative signals are an airstrike on a Karen base that damaged homes and buildings near the Thai border, reports of exploitative labour and scam networks, and the ongoing conflict backdrop.

en: Airstrike on Karen base damaging homes near Thai border
Reports of forced labour and scam networks in Myanmar
Mostly routine features and science news otherwise

summary.en: Airstrikes and an attack on a maternity clinic and school killed about 12 to 15 people, including a newborn, in Rakhine, amid ongoing conflict and pressure on free expression. Modest positives, such as FDI inflows and cooperation deals with Indonesia and China, do not offset the violence.

en: Junta airstrikes kill 12 civilians, including a newborn, in Rakhine
Reported junta attack on maternity clinic and school kills 15
Continued civilian-targeted violence and detention of deported Arakanese

summary.en: The period is dominated by ongoing armed conflict: junta offensives in Sagaing, an airstrike that killed three children at a displaced-children's school, and a court sentencing mosque trustees. Modest signals of diplomacy, including talks on election plans in Shan State and US openness to engagement, do not offset the continued violence and institutional pressure.

en: Junta airstrike kills three at school for displaced children
Renewed junta offensive in Sagaing's Indaw with heavy losses
Court seizes Shan mosque and sentences trustees to 11 years

summary.en: Domestic reporting describes junta airstrikes on monasteries and bombardments displacing civilians, alongside forced relocation fears and deportee releases. Foreign coverage is mixed and largely unrelated, with the upcoming ICJ Rohingya genocide verdict as the main institutional item; GDELT tone is clearly negative.

en: Junta airstrikes targeting monasteries in Magway during religious festival
Ongoing bombardments deepening displacement and livelihood crisis in Werathani
ICJ Rohingya genocide verdict scheduled for November 19

summary.en: The period is dominated by ongoing military violence: civilians killed in attacks, drone and airstrikes on a school and a maternity clinic, and a blockade raising starvation risk. Only minor positives appear, such as announced by-elections and El Niño preparations, so the score sits in the widespread-violence band.

en: Junta drone attack kills three female students at Karen Bible School
Airstrike on Mrauk-U maternity clinic; fighting intensifies in Kachin
Military blockade and rice price surge push Manaung Island toward starvation

summary.en: Armed conflict continued across several regions, with junta columns advancing, clashes in Rakhine, forced conscription detentions and civilian deaths in Mon State. Partial positives, such as announced by-elections and aid pledges, do not offset the ongoing violence and the strongly negative news tone.

en: Junta column advancing into Kawlin after heavy losses
Clashes intensifying in Rakhine; Ngapyi Island contested
Around 50 detained for forced conscription in Yangon

summary.en: Myanmar's domestic and foreign coverage points to ongoing armed conflict: military offensives meeting fierce resistance, an airstrike on a school sheltering displaced people that killed three children, and escalating drone warfare and forced militia recruitment. The negative tone is consistent with active war and civilian harm.

en: Airstrike on school sheltering IDPs kills three children
Military offensive toward Ponnagyun meets fierce resistance
Suicide drones and forced militia duty escalate in Karenni State

summary.en: Coverage in this window is thin and mostly off-topic, with no domestic media headlines. The relevant items are a call to keep junta leader Min Aung Hlaing out of the ASEAN Manila summit, an army statement urging calm over border news, and a pending ICJ Rohingya case, while GDELT tone is slightly more negative than the world average.

en: Calls for ASEAN to exclude Min Aung Hlaing from the Manila summit
Army urges calm over border news, says contingency plans exist
GDELT tone modestly more negative than world average

summary.en: Myanmar's civil war dominated the period, with junta airstrikes killing civilians in Arakan and Sagaing and the army claiming to seize a key resistance headquarters. Modest positives, including an extended export repatriation period and reported Dhaka talks with the Arakan Army, do not offset the violence.

en: Junta airstrikes kill civilians in Arakan and Sagaing
Army claims capture of resistance HQ and 10 bases
Export repatriation period extended to 45 days

summary.en: The period is dominated by an escalating civil war: junta airstrikes and ground offensives, army seizures of opposition bases, forced conscription, and landmine and drone attacks, plus a reported rape and murder case. Limited positives, such as the hosted ASEAN-PAC meeting, do not offset the widespread violence.

en: Junta airstrikes and ground offensives to recapture AA-held villages
Army seizes opposition headquarters and 10 bases
MNDAA forced conscription and threats of home confiscation

summary.en: Armed conflict and civilian harm continue, with fresh fighting displacing over 3,000 people on the Sagaing-Kachin border and civilians killed in Karenni State. Some routine positives, such as port volume data, diplomatic engagement with Thailand and ASEAN, and investment outreach, do not offset the serious ongoing violence.

en: Fighting displaces over 3,000 people on Sagaing-Kachin border
Civilians, including children, killed in junta attacks in Karenni
ASEAN pressure on junta over abuses; war crimes case accepted

summary.en: Myanmar's day was dominated by ongoing armed conflict, with clashes in Sagaing and Mindat, new displacement, flooding evacuations, and healthcare and aid shortages. Some diplomatic engagement (Thailand ties, US rare-earth talks, an ASEAN-PAC meeting) provided a limited offset.

en: Ongoing junta-resistance clashes and recovered soldier bodies in Sagaing
Over 400 displaced villagers and 4,950 flood evacuees needing aid
Maternal and newborn deaths amid healthcare shortages

summary.en: Myanmar's period is dominated by junta airstrikes on civilian areas, killings of civilians and displaced people, military advances forcing civilians to flee, and intensifying clashes along multiple borders. Compounding this are floods affecting thousands, soaring prices and input costs, and ASEAN disputes over excluding junta leaders.

en: Multiple airstrikes killing civilians, including a pregnant woman and at least eight at a displacement camp
Junta troop advances forcing civilians to flee; intensifying border clashes
Floods evacuating 4,950 people and submerging half of Nyaungshwe

summary.en: An airstrike on a displaced-persons camp in Rakhine killed at least 12 people, including a 5-year-old, and rights groups called the regime's airstrikes war crimes. Diplomatic and economic items (ASEAN engagement, US rare-earth talks, a vehicle import ban to conserve foreign currency) do not offset the violence.

en: Military airstrike on Rakhine displaced camp kills at least 12
Rights groups call airstrikes-for-peace claim an admission of war crimes
Vehicle import ban to conserve foreign currency signals economic strain

summary.en: Coverage is dominated by diplomacy: ASEAN is moving toward 'calibrated engagement' with Myanmar's authorities, and the ICJ genocide case over the Rohingya is pending. The UN secretary-general warns the crisis is worsening, and GDELT tone is more negative than the world average, so the score sits below an ordinary day.

en: ASEAN shifts toward calibrated engagement with Myanmar
UN chief warns of worsening Myanmar crisis
ICJ genocide case over Rohingya pending

summary.en: Fighting continues in Rakhine and Mandalay-area regions, with reports of airstrikes, bridge strikes disrupting civilian travel, and detentions of residents. International attention rose through ASEAN and UN summit statements, including an ASEAN ban on the junta leader, but these do not offset the ongoing violence.
summary.tr: Rakhine ve Mandalay bölgesine yakın alanlarda çatışmalar sürüyor; hava saldırıları, sivil ulaşımı aksatan köprü bombardımanları ve sakinlerin gözaltına alındığına dair haberler bildiriliyor. ASEAN ve BM zirvelerindeki açıklamalarla, ASEAN'ın cunta lideri hakkındaki yasağı da dahil olmak üzere, uluslararası ilgi arttı; ancak bu gelişmeler süregelen şiddeti dengelemiyor.
summary.es: Los combates continúan en Rakhine y en zonas cercanas a Mandalay, con informes de bombardeos aéreos, ataques a puentes que interrumpen el tránsito de civiles y detenciones de residentes. La atención internacional aumentó con declaraciones de cumbres de la ASEAN y la ONU, incluida una prohibición de la ASEAN contra el líder de la junta, pero estas medidas no compensan la violencia en curso.
summary.fr: Les combats se poursuivent dans l'État de Rakhine et dans des régions proches de Mandalay, avec des informations faisant état de frappes aériennes, de bombardements de ponts perturbant les déplacements des civils et de détentions de résidents. L'attention internationale s'est accrue à travers les déclarations des sommets de l'ASEAN et de l'ONU, y compris une interdiction de l'ASEAN visant le chef de la junte, mais ces mesures ne compensent pas les violences en cours.
summary.de: In Rakhine und in Gebieten nahe Mandalay dauern die Kämpfe an; berichtet wird über Luftangriffe, Brückenbombardements, die den zivilen Verkehr stören, sowie Festnahmen von Einwohnern. Die internationale Aufmerksamkeit ist durch Erklärungen der ASEAN- und UN-Gipfel gestiegen, darunter ein ASEAN-Einreiseverbot gegen den Junta-Chef, doch diese Schritte wiegen die anhaltende Gewalt nicht auf.
summary.pt: Os combates continuam em Rakhine e em regiões próximas a Mandalay, com relatos de ataques aéreos, bombardeios a pontes que perturbam a circulação de civis e detenções de moradores. A atenção internacional aumentou com declarações das cúpulas da ASEAN e da ONU, incluindo uma proibição da ASEAN contra o líder da junta, mas essas medidas não compensam a violência em curso.
summary.it: I combattimenti continuano nelle regioni di Rakhine e nell'area di Mandalay, con segnalazioni di attacchi aerei, bombardamenti di ponti che ostacolano gli spostamenti dei civili e detenzioni di residenti. L'attenzione internazionale è cresciuta attraverso le dichiarazioni dei vertici dell'ASEAN e delle Nazioni Unite, incluso un divieto dell'ASEAN nei confronti del leader della giunta, ma questi sviluppi non compensano la violenza in corso.
summary.ru: Боевые действия продолжаются в штате Ракхайн и в районах вокруг Мандалая: поступают сообщения об авиаударах, ударах по мостам, нарушающих передвижение гражданского населения, и задержаниях жителей. Внимание международного сообщества возросло благодаря заявлениям на саммитах АСЕАН и ООН, включая запрет АСЕАН для лидера хунты, однако это не компенсирует продолжающееся насилие.
summary.ar: تتواصل الاشتباكات في منطقة راخين والمناطق المحيطة بماندالاي، مع تقارير عن غارات جوية وضربات استهدفت جسورا عطلت تنقل المدنيين، واحتجاز سكان. وازداد الاهتمام الدولي من خلال بيانات قمم رابطة أمم جنوب شرق آسيا (آسيان) والأمم المتحدة، بما في ذلك حظر الرابطة على زعيم المجلس العسكري، لكن هذه الخطوات لا تعوض استمرار العنف.
summary.fa: درگیری‌ها در منطقه راخین و نواحی اطراف ماندالای ادامه دارد و گزارش‌هایی از حملات هوایی، بمباران پل‌ها که رفت‌وآمد غیرنظامیان را مختل کرده، و بازداشت ساکنان منتشر شده است. توجه بین‌المللی از طریق بیانیه‌های نشست‌های آسه‌آن و سازمان ملل افزایش یافته، از جمله ممنوعیت آسه‌آن برای رهبر جunta، اما این اقدامات خشونت جاری را جبران نمی‌کند.
summary.zh: 若开邦及曼德勒周边地区的战斗仍在持续，据报道有空袭、炸毁桥梁致使平民出行受阻，以及居民被拘押。东盟和联合国峰会的声明提升了国际关注，其中包括东盟对军政府领导人的禁令，但这些措施无法抵消持续的暴力。
summary.ja: ラカイン州およびマンダレー周辺地域で戦闘が続いており、空爆や、民間人の移動を妨げる橋梁への攻撃、住民の拘束が報告されています。ASEANと国連の首脳会議声明では国際的な関心が高まり、ASEANは軍事政権指導者に対する入国禁止措置を発表しましたが、これらは続く暴力を相殺するものではありません。
summary.ko: 라카인주와 만달레이 인근 지역에서 전투가 계속되고 있으며, 공습, 민간인 이동을 방해하는 다리 공격, 주민 구금이 보고되고 있습니다. ASEAN과 유엔 정상회의 성명을 통해 국제적 관심이 높아졌고, ASEAN은 군사정권 지도자에 대한 입국 금지 조치를 취했으나, 이러한 조치들이 지속되는 폭력을 상쇄하지는 못하고 있습니다.
summary.hi: रखाइन और मांडले के आसपास के क्षेत्रों में लड़ाई जारी है, जहाँ हवाई हमलों, नागरिकों की आवाजाही बाधित करने वाले पुलों पर हमलों और निवासियों की हिरासत की खबरें हैं। ASEAN और संयुक्त राष्ट्र शिखर सम्मेलन के बयानों से अंतरराष्ट्रीय ध्यान बढ़ा है, जिसमें ASEAN द्वारा जुंटा नेता पर प्रतिबंध भी शामिल है, लेकिन ये कदम जारी हिंसा की भरपाई नहीं करते।
summary.el: Οι μάχες συνεχίζονται στο Ρακάιν και σε περιοχές κοντά στο Μανταλέι, με αναφορές για αεροπορικές επιδρομές, χτυπήματα σε γέφυρες που διαταράσσουν τις μετακινήσεις αμάχων και κρατήσεις κατοίκων. Η διεθνής προσοχή αυξήθηκε μέσω των δηλώσεων των συνόδων κορυφής της ASEAN και του ΟΗΕ, συμπεριλαμβανομένης της απαγόρευσης εισόδου της ASEAN στον ηγέτη της χούντας, ωστόσο αυτά δεν αντισταθμίζουν τη συνεχιζόμενη βία.

Bunları sert bir piyasa düşüşü (KOSPI ay içinde %12, gün içinde %2,6 düştü) ve bir üniversite giriş sınavı kopya skandalı dengeliyor.
summary.es: El periodo fue en gran medida rutinario: el FMI elevó su previsión de crecimiento para 2026 al 3,9 % y el OLED coreano se situó, según se informa, en primer lugar a nivel mundial, ambos datos positivos. Estos se ven compensados por una fuerte caída del mercado (el KOSPI bajó un 12 % en el mes y un 2,6 % en la jornada) y un escándalo de trampas en el examen de acceso a la universidad.
summary.fr: La période a été largement routinière : le FMI a relevé sa prévision de croissance pour 2026 à 3,9 % et l'OLED coréen aurait été classé premier au niveau mondial, deux éléments positifs. Ils sont compensés par un net repli des marchés (KOSPI en baisse de 12 % sur le mois et de 2,6 % sur la journée) et un scandale de triche à l'examen d'entrée à l'université.
summary.de: Der Zeitraum verlief weitgehend routinemäßig: Der IWF hob seine Wachstumsprognose für 2026 auf 3,9 % an, und koreanische OLED-Technik soll weltweit auf Platz eins gelegen haben, beides positive Nachrichten. Dem stehen ein deutlicher Kursrückgang (KOSPI im Monatsverlauf minus 12 %, am Tag minus 2,6 %) und ein Betrugsskandal bei der Hochschulzugangsprüfung gegenüber.
summary.pt: O período foi em grande parte rotineiro: o FMI elevou sua previsão de crescimento para 2026 para 3,9% e o OLED coreano foi, segundo relatos, classificado em primeiro lugar no mundo, ambos fatores positivos. Isso é compensado por uma forte queda do mercado (o KOSPI recuou 12% no mês e 2,6% no dia) e por um escândalo de fraude no exame de admissão universitária.
summary.ja: この期間は概ね平穏で、IMFは2026年の成長率予測を3.9%に引き上げ、韓国の有機EL（OLED）は世界首位と報じられました。いずれも前向きな材料です。一方で、株式市場は急落（KOSPIは1か月で12%下落、当日は2.6%下落）し、大学入試での不正行為スキャンダルも発生しました。

summary.hi: यह अवधि काफ़ी हद तक सामान्य रही: IMF ने 2026 के लिए विकास पूर्वानुमान बढ़ाकर 3.9% किया और कोरियाई OLED के विश्व में प्रथम स्थान पर होने की खबर आई, दोनों सकारात्मक हैं। इनके विपरीत बाज़ार में तेज़ गिरावट आई (एक महीने में KOSPI 12% नीचे, और एक दिन में 2.6% नीचे) तथा एक विश्वविद्यालय प्रवेश परीक्षा में नकल का घोटाला भी सामने आया।
summary.el: Η περίοδος ήταν σε μεγάλο βαθμό συνηθισμένη: το ΔΝΤ αύξησε την πρόβλεψη ανάπτυξής του για το 2026 στο 3,9% και αναφέρθηκε ότι η κορεατική τεχνολογία OLED κατέλαβε την πρώτη θέση παγκοσμίως, και τα δύο θετικά. Αντισταθμίζονται από μια απότομη πτώση της αγοράς (ο δείκτης KOSPI υποχώρησε κατά 12% μέσα στον μήνα και κατά 2,6% την ημέρα) και ένα σκάνδαλο αντιγραφής στις εξετάσεις εισαγωγής στα πανεπιστήμια.
summary.it: Il periodo è in gran parte di routine: il FMI ha alzato le previsioni di crescita della Corea per il 2026 al 3,9% e l'OLED coreano si sarebbe classificato al primo posto a livello mondiale, entrambi dati positivi. Questi sono compensati da un forte calo del mercato (KOSPI in calo del 12% nel mese e del 2,6% nella giornata) e da uno scandalo di imbrogli negli esami di ammissione all'università.
summary.ru: Период в основном рутинный: МВФ повысил прогноз роста экономики Кореи на 2026 год до 3,9%, а корейские OLED-технологии, по сообщениям, заняли первое место в мире; оба фактора положительны. Их перевешивает резкое падение рынка (индекс KOSPI снизился на 12% за месяц и на 2,6% за день) и скандал со списыванием на вступительных экзаменах в университеты.
summary.ar: الفترة روتينية إلى حد كبير: رفع صندوق النقد الدولي توقعاته لنمو كوريا الجنوبية لعام 2026 إلى 3.9%، وذُكر أن تقنية OLED الكورية احتلت المركز الأول عالمياً، وكلاهما إيجابي. ويقابل ذلك تراجع حاد في السوق (انخفاض مؤشر KOSPI بنسبة 12% خلال الشهر و2.6% في اليوم الواحد) وفضيحة غش في امتحانات القبول الجامعي.

summary.hi: इस अवधि की खबरें ज़्यादातर नियमित हैं: आर्थिक और सामाजिक रिपोर्टिंग, नियुक्तियाँ, और कुछ सकारात्मक बातें जैसे $14.3M का K-food निर्यात सौदा, रोज़गार सृजन के आँकड़े और बढ़ता बिजली उत्पादन। नकारात्मक बातों में अतिराउ में खसरे से एक बच्चे की मौत, वहाँ ऊर्जा और उपयोगिता सेवाओं में व्यवधान, एक स्कूल में चाकूबाज़ी, और उच्च-स्तरीय भ्रष्टाचार की गिरफ़्तारियाँ शामिल हैं, जिससे कुल स्कोर लगभग तटस्थ बना रहता है।
summary.el: Η περίοδος είναι κυρίως ρουτίνα: οικονομικό και κοινωνικό ρεπορτάζ, διορισμοί και μετρίως θετικά γεγονότα, όπως μια συμφωνία εξαγωγής K-food ύψους $14.3M, στοιχεία για δημιουργία θέσεων εργασίας και αυξανόμενη παραγωγή ηλεκτρικής ενέργειας. Τα αρνητικά περιλαμβάνουν έναν θάνατο από ιλαρά στο Ατιράου, διατάραξη ενέργειας και κοινής ωφέλειας εκεί, μια επίθεση με μαχαίρι σε σχολείο και συλλήψεις για διαφθορά υψηλού επιπέδου, που διατηρούν τη βαθμολογία κοντά στο ουδέτερο.
summary.it: Il periodo è per lo più di routine: resoconti economici e sociali, nomine e alcune notizie positive moderate, come un accordo da $14.3M per l'esportazione di K-food, dati sulla creazione di posti di lavoro e la crescita della produzione di elettricità. Tra gli aspetti negativi figurano un decesso per morbillo ad Atyrau, un'interruzione nel settore energetico e dei servizi pubblici in quella regione, un accoltellamento in una scuola e arresti per corruzione ad alto livello, che mantengono il punteggio vicino alla neutralità.
summary.ru: Период в основном рутинный: экономические и социальные новости, назначения и умеренно позитивные события, такие как контракт на экспорт K-food на $14.3M, данные о создании рабочих мест и рост выработки электроэнергии. Негативные моменты включают смерть ребёнка от кори в Атырау, сбой в энергетике и коммунальном хозяйстве этого региона, поножовщину в школе и аресты высокопоставленных чиновников по делам о коррупции, что удерживает оценку близко к нейтральной.
summary.ar: الفترة روتينية في معظمها: تقارير اقتصادية واجتماعية وتعيينات، إلى جانب أخبار إيجابية معتدلة مثل صفقة تصدير أطعمة كورية بقيمة $14.3M، وأرقام عن خلق فرص العمل وارتفاع إنتاج الكهرباء. وتشمل الجوانب السلبية وفاة طفل بالحصبة في أتيراو، واضطراباً في قطاع الطاقة والمرافق هناك، وطعناً في مدرسة، واعتقالات بتهم فساد رفيعة المستوى، ما يبقي التقييم قريباً من الحياد.
summary.fa: این دوره عمدتاً روال‌گونه است: گزارش‌های اقتصادی و اجتماعی، انتصابات و موارد مثبت متوسطی مانند قرارداد صادراتی $14.3M برای غذای کره‌ای، آمار ایجاد شغل و افزایش تولید برق. موارد منفی شامل مرگ یک کودک بر اثر سرخک در آتیراو، اختلال در بخش انرژی و خدمات عمومی آن منطقه، حمله با چاقو در یک مدرسه و دستگیری‌های فساد در سطوح بالا است که امتیاز کلی را نزدیک به خنثی نگه می‌دارد.
summary.zh: 这一时期大多属于常规内容：经济与社会报道、人事任命，以及一些温和的正面消息，例如价值$14.3M的韩式食品出口协议、就业增长数据和电力产量回升。负面内容包括阿特劳发生一例麻疹儿童死亡、该地能源与公用事业中断、一起校园刺伤事件，以及高层腐败逮捕，使整体评分接近中性。
summary.tr: Dönem büyük ölçüde rutin: ekonomi ve toplumsal haberler, atamalar ve ılımlı olumlu gelişmeler; örneğin $14.3M değerinde bir K-food ihracat anlaşması, iş yaratma rakamları ve artan elektrik üretimi. Olumsuz gelişmeler arasında Atyrau'da bir kızamık ölümü, oradaki enerji ve kamu hizmetleri aksaklığı, bir okulda bıçaklama olayı ve üst düzey yolsuzluk tutuklamaları yer alıyor; bu da puanı nötr düzeyde tutuyor.
summary.es: El periodo es en su mayoría rutinario: informes económicos y sociales, nombramientos y noticias positivas moderadas, como un acuerdo de exportación de K-food por $14.3M, cifras de creación de empleo y el aumento de la producción de electricidad. Entre los aspectos negativos figuran una muerte por sarampión en Atyrau, una interrupción de la energía y los servicios públicos en esa ciudad, un apuñalamiento en una escuela y detenciones por corrupción de alto nivel, lo que mantiene la puntuación cerca de neutral.
summary.fr: La période est en grande partie routinière : reportages économiques et sociaux, nominations, et éléments positifs modestes tels qu'un accord d'exportation de K-food de 14,3 M$, des chiffres de création d'emplois et une hausse de la production d'électricité. Les éléments négatifs comprennent un décès par rougeole à Atyrau, une perturbation de l'énergie et des services publics dans cette ville, un coup de couteau dans une école et des arrestations pour corruption de haut niveau, ce qui maintient le score près de la neutralité.
summary.de: Der Zeitraum verläuft überwiegend routinemäßig: Wirtschafts- und Gesellschaftsberichte, Personalentscheidungen sowie moderate positive Meldungen wie ein K-Food-Exportabkommen über $14.3M, Zahlen zur Schaffung von Arbeitsplätzen und eine steigende Stromerzeugung. Negative Punkte sind ein Masern-Todesfall in Atyrau, eine Störung der Energie- und Versorgungsdienste dort, ein Messerangriff an einer Schule sowie Festnahmen wegen hochrangiger Korruption, wodurch die Bewertung nahe am neutralen Bereich bleibt.
summary.pt: O período é em grande parte rotineiro: reportagens econômicas e sociais, nomeações e itens positivos moderados, como um acordo de exportação de K-food de US$ 14,3 milhões, dados de criação de empregos e aumento da produção de eletricidade. Os aspectos negativos incluem uma morte por sarampo em Atyrau, uma interrupção de energia e serviços públicos naquela cidade, um esfaqueamento em uma escola e prisões por corrupção de alto nível, o que mantém a pontuação próxima do neutro.

summary.en: The period in Uruguay is calm and routine. The finding of a missing teenager in Argentina, the approach to a green hydrogen agreement with HIF Global, and the resilient-economy message presented to the IMF stand out. Negative headlines remained limited: an Antel outage, flooding of the Uruguay River and a waste problem. Because no clear crisis is visible and the GDELT tone is much more positive than the world average, the score is slightly above the midpoint.

en: Approaching an agreement with HIF Global for a green hydrogen plant in Paysandú
The government presenting its resilient-economy and growth agenda at the IMF
Finding of the missing teenager through a joint Uruguay-Argentina operation
Limited problems from the Antel outage and river flooding

Негативных материалов, включая утверждения о межэтнической напряжённости на юге и дело о взятках, связанное с незаконной добычей золота, было немного, поэтому оценка немного выше, чем в обычный день.
summary.ar: كانت الفترة روتينية في معظمها: حوار دبلوماسي مع الاتحاد الأوروبي، وتوسيع تمويل الرعاية الصحية وتسليم سيارات إسعاف، والاستعدادات للانتخابات الرئاسية. وكانت البنود السلبية، ومنها ادعاءات بتوترات عرقية في الجنوب وقضية رشوة مرتبطة بتعدين الذهب غير المشروع، محدودة، لذلك يقع التقييم أعلى قليلاً من يوم عادي.
summary.fa: این دوره عمدتاً عادی بود: گفتگوی دیپلماتیک با اتحادیه اروپا، افزایش بودجه بهداشت و درمان و تحویل آمبولانس‌ها، و آماده‌سازی برای انتخابات ریاست‌جمهوری. موارد منفی، از جمله ادعاهای مربوط به تنش قومی در جنوب و پرونده رشوه مرتبط با استخراج غیرقانونی طلا، محدود بود، بنابراین امتیاز کمی بالاتر از یک روز معمولی است.
summary.zh: 该时段总体属于常规情况：与欧盟的外交对话、医疗资金增加及救护车交付，以及总统选举的筹备工作。负面内容较少，包括关于南部民族紧张局势的指控以及非法采金贿赂案，因此评分略高于普通一天。
summary.tr: Dönem büyük ölçüde rutin geçti: AB ile diplomatik diyalog, artırılmış sağlık finansmanı ve ambulans teslimatları ile cumhurbaşkanlığı seçimine yönelik hazırlıklar öne çıktı. Güneydeki etnik gerilim iddiaları ve yasa dışı altın madenciliğiyle ilgili rüşvet davası gibi olumsuz haberler sınırlı kaldı; bu nedenle skor sıradan bir günün biraz üzerinde.
summary.es: El periodo transcurrió en su mayoría con normalidad: diálogo diplomático con la UE, mayor financiación sanitaria y entregas de ambulancias, y preparativos para las elecciones presidenciales. Los aspectos negativos, como las denuncias de tensiones étnicas en el sur y un caso de soborno relacionado con la minería ilegal de oro, fueron limitados, por lo que la puntuación se sitúa ligeramente por encima de un día ordinario.
summary.fr: La période a été globalement routinière : dialogue diplomatique avec l'UE, hausse du financement de la santé et livraisons d'ambulances, et préparatifs de l'élection présidentielle. Les éléments négatifs, notamment les allégations de tensions ethniques dans le sud et une affaire de corruption liée à l'orpaillage illégal, sont restés limités, si bien que le score se situe légèrement au-dessus d'une journée ordinaire.
summary.de: Der Zeitraum verlief überwiegend routinemäßig: diplomatischer Dialog mit der EU, aufgestockte Mittel für das Gesundheitswesen und Auslieferungen von Krankenwagen sowie Vorbereitungen auf die Präsidentschaftswahl. Negative Meldungen, darunter Behauptungen über ethnische Spannungen im Süden und ein Bestechungsfall im Zusammenhang mit illegalem Goldbergbau, blieben begrenzt, sodass der Wert knapp über einem gewöhnlichen Tag liegt.
summary.pt: O período foi, em grande parte, rotineiro: diálogo diplomático com a UE, aumento do financiamento da saúde e entrega de ambulâncias, além dos preparativos para a eleição presidencial. Os itens negativos, incluindo alegações de tensão étnica no sul e um caso de suborno relacionado à mineração ilegal de ouro, foram limitados, de modo que a pontuação fica ligeiramente acima de um dia comum.
summary.ja: この期間は概ね平常通りで、EUとの外交対話、医療予算の拡充と救急車の引き渡し、大統領選挙の準備が主な内容でした。南部での民族間緊張の主張や違法金採掘に関する贈賄事件などの否定的な項目は限定的だったため、スコアは通常の一日よりわずかに高くなっています。
summary.ko: 이번 기간은 대체로 평이했습니다. EU와의 외교 대화, 보건의료 예산 확대와 구급차 인도, 대통령 선거 준비가 주요 내용이었습니다. 남부 지역의 민족 간 긴장 주장과 불법 금광 관련 뇌물 사건 등 부정적 사안은 제한적이어서, 점수는 일반적인 하루보다 약간 높게 나타났습니다.
summary.hi: यह अवधि अधिकतर सामान्य रही: यूरोपीय संघ के साथ राजनयिक संवाद, स्वास्थ्य सेवा के लिए बढ़ा हुआ वित्तपोषण और एम्बुलेंस की आपूर्ति, तथा राष्ट्रपति चुनाव की तैयारियाँ। दक्षिण में जातीय तनाव के दावे और अवैध सोना खनन से जुड़े रिश्वत मामले जैसी नकारात्मक खबरें सीमित रहीं, इसलिए स्कोर एक सामान्य दिन से थोड़ा अधिक है।
summary.el: Η περίοδος ήταν κυρίως συνηθισμένη: διπλωματικός διάλογος με την ΕΕ, αυξημένη χρηματοδότηση υγειονομικής περίθαλψης και παράδοση ασθενοφόρων, και προετοιμασίες για τις προεδρικές εκλογές. Τα αρνητικά θέματα, όπως οι ισχυρισμοί για εθνοτική ένταση στο νότο και υπόθεση δωροδοκίας σχετικά με την παράνομη εξόρυξη χρυσού, ήταν περιορισμένα, γι' αυτό η βαθμολογία βρίσκεται ελαφρώς πάνω από μια συνηθισμένη ημέρα.

Growth is accelerating, but consumers prefer saving to spending

Tension over a US warship in the South China Sea and a debate with India over the Ladakh/Aksai Chin rhetoric
Reports of the closure of schools in Tibet and of hidden unemployment

summary.ja: 中国の一日は概ね建設的だった。カナダとの関税引き下げ、APEC首脳会議の開催と複数の首脳との外交、国内の不動産・証券に関する前向きな報道があった。一方で、米国による新たな半導体輸出規制を受けて株価指数は数か月来の安値付近にあり、スコアは通常の一日よりやや高い水準にとどまっている。
summary.ko: 중국의 하루는 대체로 건설적이었다. 캐나다와의 관세 인하, APEC 정상회의 개최 및 여러 정상과의 외교, 국내 부동산 및 증권 관련 긍정적 보도가 있었다. 반면 미국의 새로운 반도체 수출 규제로 주가지수는 수개월 만의 저점 부근에 머물러, 점수는 평범한 하루보다 다소 높은 수준을 유지하고 있다.
summary.hi: चीन का दिन ज़्यादातर रचनात्मक रहा: कनाडा के साथ शुल्क में और कटौती, APEC शिखर सम्मेलन की मेज़बानी और कई नेताओं के साथ कूटनीति, तथा घरेलू संपत्ति और प्रतिभूति बाज़ार की सकारात्मक रिपोर्टिंग। इसके विपरीत, अमेरिका की नई चिप निर्यात पाबंदियों के बीच शेयर सूचकांक कई महीनों के निचले स्तर के आसपास है, इसलिए स्कोर एक सामान्य दिन से कुछ ऊपर बना हुआ है।
summary.el: Η ημέρα της Κίνας ήταν κυρίως εποικοδομητική: μειώσεις δασμών με τον Καναδά, φιλοξενία της συνόδου κορυφής APEC και διπλωματία με πολλούς ηγέτες, καθώς και θετική κάλυψη για την εγχώρια αγορά ακινήτων και κινητών αξιών. Αντίθετα, ο δείκτης μετοχών βρίσκεται κοντά σε χαμηλά πολλών μηνών εξαιτίας των νέων αμερικανικών περιορισμών στις εξαγωγές chip, έτσι η βαθμολογία παραμένει μετρίως πάνω από μια συνηθισμένη ημέρα.
summary.it: La giornata in Cina è stata nel complesso costruttiva: tagli tariffari con il Canada, l'ospitalità del vertice APEC e la diplomazia con più leader, e una copertura ottimistica del settore immobiliare e dei titoli domestici. Di segno opposto, l'indice azionario si trova vicino ai minimi di diversi mesi a causa delle nuove restrizioni statunitensi all'export di chip, per cui il punteggio resta moderatamente sopra una giornata ordinaria.
summary.ru: День в Китае в целом был конструктивным: снижение тарифов с Канадой, проведение саммита АТЭС и дипломатические контакты с несколькими лидерами, а также оптимистичное освещение внутреннего рынка недвижимости и ценных бумаг. В противовес этому индекс акций находится вблизи многомесячных минимумов на фоне новых ограничений США на экспорт чипов, поэтому оценка остаётся умеренно выше обычного дня.
summary.ar: كان يوم الصين بشكل عام بناءً: خفض الرسوم الجمركية مع كندا، واستضافة قمة إيبك والدبلوماسية مع عدد من القادة، وتغطية متفائلة للعقارات والأوراق المالية المحلية. في المقابل، يقترب مؤشر الأسهم من أدنى مستوياته في عدة أشهر بسبب قيود التصدير الأمريكية الجديدة على الرقائق، لذا يبقى التقييم أعلى بقدر معتدل من يوم عادي.
summary.fa: روز چین در مجموع سازنده بود: کاهش تعرفه‌ها با کانادا، میزبانی از اجلاس اپک و دیپلماسی با چند رهبر، و پوشش مثبت بازار مسکن و اوراق بهادار داخلی. در مقابل، شاخص سهام در نزدیکی کمترین سطح چند ماهه خود قرار دارد، به دلیل محدودیت‌های جدید آمریکا بر صادرات تراشه، بنابراین امتیاز همچنان اندکی بالاتر از یک روز عادی باقی می‌ماند.
summary.zh: 中国当日总体上较为积极：与加拿大达成进一步降低关税的协议，主办亚太经合组织（APEC）峰会并与多国领导人会晤，国内房地产和证券领域的报道也较为乐观。与此相对，受美国新的芯片出口限制影响，股指接近数月来的低点，因此综合评分仍略高于普通的一天。
summary.tr: Çin'in gününün çoğu yapıcı geçti: Kanada ile tarife indirimleri, APEC ev sahipliği ve birden fazla liderle diplomasi, ayrıca olumlu içerikli yerel emlak ve menkul kıymet haberleri öne çıktı. Buna karşın, yeni ABD çip ihracat kısıtlamaları nedeniyle borsa endeksi birkaç aylık dibe yakın seyrediyor; bu nedenle skor sıradan bir günün biraz üzerinde kalıyor.
summary.es: El día de China fue en su mayoría constructivo: recortes arancelarios con Canadá, la presidencia de la cumbre del APEC y diplomacia con varios líderes, además de una cobertura optimista del sector inmobiliario y bursátil nacional. En cambio, el índice bursátil se sitúa cerca de mínimos de varios meses por las nuevas restricciones de exportación de chips de Estados Unidos, por lo que la puntuación se mantiene moderadamente por encima de un día ordinario.
summary.fr: La journée en Chine a été majoritairement constructive : baisses de droits de douane avec le Canada, accueil du sommet de l'APEC et diplomatie avec plusieurs dirigeants, ainsi qu'une couverture favorable de l'immobilier et des marchés boursiers nationaux. En revanche, l'indice boursier se situe près de ses plus bas de plusieurs mois en raison de nouvelles restrictions américaines sur les exportations de puces, de sorte que le score reste modérément supérieur à celui d'une journée ordinaire.
summary.de: Der Tag in China verlief überwiegend konstruktiv: Zollsenkungen mit Kanada, die Ausrichtung des APEC-Gipfels und Diplomatie mit mehreren Staats- und Regierungschefs sowie eine optimistische Berichterstattung über den heimischen Immobilien- und Wertpapiermarkt. Dem steht entgegen, dass der Aktienindex wegen neuer US-Exportbeschränkungen für Chips nahe seinen Mehrmonatstiefs liegt, sodass der Wert insgesamt moderat über einem gewöhnlichen Tag liegt.
summary.pt: O dia na China foi, em grande parte, construtivo: cortes tarifários com o Canadá, a sediação da cúpula da APEC e diplomacia com vários líderes, além de uma cobertura otimista do mercado imobiliário e de valores mobiliários do país. Em contrapartida, o índice da bolsa está perto das mínimas de vários meses devido às novas restrições dos EUA à exportação de chips, de modo que a pontuação permanece moderadamente acima de um dia comum.

en: China and Canada agree to further tariff cuts

summary.fa: بیشتر تیتر خبرها به پوشش ورزشی اختصاص دارد که از ارزیابی مستثناست. بقیه اخبار عادی هستند: جدا شدن یک عضو از حزب، بحثی درباره بودجه آموزش در شرایط احتمال کاهش بودجه، حکم قاچاق مواد مخدر و خبرهای گردشگری. لحن اخبار نسبت به میانگین منفی جهانی اندکی مثبت است و از این رو امتیاز کمی بالاتر از یک روز معمولی قرار می‌گیرد.
summary.zh: 大多数标题为体育报道，已排除在评估之外。其余新闻属于常规内容：一名党派成员转党、在可能削减开支背景下关于教育经费的辩论、一起毒品走私判决以及旅游相关报道。相较于负面的全球平均水平，整体语调略为正面，因此得分略高于普通一天。
summary.ja: 見出しの大半はスポーツ報道であり、評価の対象からは除外されています。残りのニュースは日常的なもので、党からの離党、予算削減の可能性をめぐる教育資金の議論、麻薬密売の判決、観光関連の記事などです。全体の論調は、世界平均がネガティブな中でやや前向きであり、そのためスコアは通常の一日よりわずかに高くなっています。

summary.el: Τα περισσότερα επικεφαλίδες αφορούν αθλητική κάλυψη, η οποία εξαιρείται από την αξιολόγηση. Οι υπόλοιπες ειδήσεις είναι συνηθισμένες: η αποχώρηση ενός βουλευτή από κόμμα, μια συζήτηση για τη χρηματοδότηση της εκπαίδευσης εν μέσω πιθανών περικοπών, μια ποινή για trafficking ναρκωτικών και ειδήσεις για τον τουρισμό. Ο τόνος είναι ελαφρά θετικός σε σύγκριση με έναν αρνητικό παγκόσμιο μέσο όρο, γι' αυτό η βαθμολογία βρίσκεται ελαφρώς πάνω από μια συνηθισμένη ημέρα.

summary.en: A landslide and collapse at an illegal gold mine killed 14 people and injured 7. Separately, a Black Hawk helicopter crashed in Cauca, the investigation into the assassination of Miguel Uribe is in the news, debate over militarizing Bogotá is ongoing, and the stock market fell 2.15% in a day. In contrast, Bogotá, Cali and Medellín ranked among the top 10 in Latin America for economic performance, received tourism awards, and economy and infrastructure news was calm, so the score did not drop much.

en: Collapse at an illegal gold mine with 14 deaths
Military helicopter crash in Cauca
Daily stock market decline of 2.15%
Investigation into the assassination of Miguel Uribe and debate over militarization in Bogotá
Positive news on the economic performance and tourism awards of major cities

Positives include a signed US-Colombia critical minerals and nuclear cooperation arrangement, while the stock index was roughly flat and the news tone was more negative than the global average.

Illegal gold mine landslide kills 14 people
US-Colombia critical minerals and civil nuclear arrangements signed

summary.en: The period is dominated by a cabinet shake-up after the Presidency's budget setback, plus protests over the removal of museum artworks and warnings about gas prices and a blackout bill. Offsetting this are a record cocaine seizure, a routine IMF mission and port throughput above target, so the day sits slightly below an ordinary period.

Protests over removal of art exhibits deemed communist
Record 7.6-tonne cocaine seizure at Cartagena port

summary.en: The day mixed a positive corporate rescue (700 jobs saved at Presto) and IDB financing with a cabinet resignation, a deadly military strike on an ELN camp, a journalist's murder by dissidents, and a 0.74% stock decline. Air strike killed nine ELN members in Cauca
Journalist Mateo Pérez Rueda's murder by dissidents, forensic details released

summary.en: The period is mixed: the central bank raised rates to 12.25% and the government postponed over 10 trillion pesos in debt payments, while security and institutional items (an extradition, an anti-ELN seizure, stable homicide levels) were routine or mildly positive. The COLCAP index is down 2.9% over the month, and the news tone is slightly less negative than the world average.

summary.en: The period looks mostly routine: post-election politics, a fiscal adjustment outlook, and regional flooding, alongside a police officer's killing in Cali and an arrest of FARC dissidents. Flooding and traffic chaos in the Caribbean region

At least six killed in attack in southwestern Colombia

summary.ja: 当日は情勢が入り混じっており、ウイラ県での警察への攻撃や鉱山爆発事故による死亡事故が、殺人件数の減少や Ecopetrol の好調な決算に関する報道と相殺し合っています。市場データはやや軟調で、ニュースの論調も世界平均よりやや否定的なため、スコアは通常の日をわずかに下回っています。
summary.ko: 이날은 엇갈린 흐름이었습니다. 우일라주의 경찰 대상 공격과 광산 폭발로 인한 사망 사고가 살인 사건 감소 보고 및 Ecopetrol의 강한 실적과 상충했습니다. 시장 데이터는 소폭 약세이고 뉴스 어조도 세계 평균보다 다소 부정적이어서, 점수는 평범한 날보다 약간 낮습니다.
summary.hi: दिन मिश्रित रहा: वीला में पुलिस पर हमले और एक घातक खदान विस्फोट की घटनाएँ हत्याओं में कमी की रिपोर्टों और Ecopetrol की मज़बूत कमाई के मुकाबले भारी पड़ीं। बाज़ार के आंकड़े थोड़े कमज़ोर हैं और समाचार का लहजा विश्व औसत से कुछ अधिक नकारात्मक है, इसलिए स्कोर एक सामान्य दिन से थोड़ा नीचे है।
summary.el: Η ημέρα ήταν μικτή: οι επιθέσεις κατά της αστυνομίας στο Ουίλα και μια θανατηφόρα έκρηξη σε ορυχείο υπερτερούν έναντι των αναφορών για μείωση των ανθρωποκτονιών και των ισχυρών κερδών της Ecopetrol. Τα στοιχεία της αγοράς είναι ελαφρώς αδύναμα και ο τόνος των ειδήσεων είναι κάπως πιο αρνητικός από τον παγκόσμιο μέσο όρο, οπότε η βαθμολογία βρίσκεται ελαφρώς κάτω από μια συνηθισμένη ημέρα.
summary.tr: Karışık bir gün: Huila'daki polise yönelik saldırılar ve ölümlü bir maden patlaması, bildirilen cinayet oranlarındaki düşüş ve Ecopetrol'ün güçlü kazançlarıyla dengeleniyor. Piyasa verileri hafifçe zayıf ve haber tonu dünya ortalamasına kıyasla biraz daha olumsuz; bu nedenle skor olağan bir günün hemen altında yer alıyor.
summary.es: Jornada mixta: los ataques contra la policía en Huila y una explosión fatal en una mina pesan frente a las caídas reportadas en los homicidios y los sólidos resultados de Ecopetrol. Los datos de mercado son ligeramente débiles y el tono de las noticias es algo más negativo que la media mundial, por lo que la puntuación queda justo por debajo de un día ordinario.
summary.fr: Journée contrastée : les attaques contre la police dans le Huila et une explosion mortelle dans une mine pèsent face aux baisses signalées des homicides et aux solides résultats d'Ecopetrol. Les données de marché sont légèrement faibles et le ton de l'actualité est un peu plus négatif que la moyenne mondiale, si bien que le score se situe juste en dessous d'une journée ordinaire.
summary.de: Gemischter Tag: Angriffe auf die Polizei in Huila und eine tödliche Minenexplosion wiegen schwerer als die gemeldeten Rückgänge bei den Tötungsdelikten und die starken Ergebnisse von Ecopetrol. Die Marktdaten sind leicht schwach, und der Nachrichtenton ist etwas negativer als der weltweite Durchschnitt, daher liegt der Wert knapp unter einem gewöhnlichen Tag.
summary.pt: Dia misto: ataques a policiais em Huila e uma explosão fatal em uma mina pesam contra as quedas relatadas nos homicídios e os fortes resultados da Ecopetrol. Os dados de mercado estão ligeiramente fracos e o tom das notícias é um pouco mais negativo que a média mundial, portanto a pontuação fica logo abaixo de um dia comum.
summary.it: Giornata mista: gli attacchi contro la polizia nell'Huila e un'esplosione mortale in una miniera controbilanciano le riduzioni segnalate negli omicidi e i solidi utili di Ecopetrol. I dati di mercato sono leggermente deboli e il tono delle notizie è un po' più negativo della media mondiale, quindi il punteggio si colloca appena sotto una giornata ordinaria.
summary.ru: День неоднозначный: нападения на полицию в Уиле и смертельный взрыв на шахте перевешивают сообщения о снижении числа убийств и высокую прибыль Ecopetrol. Рыночные данные слегка слабые, а тон новостей несколько более негативный, чем в среднем по миру, поэтому показатель немного ниже обычного дня.
summary.ar: يوم مختلط: تتفوق الهجمات على الشرطة في وילا وانفجار منجم أودى بحياة عمال على تقارير انخفاض جرائم القتل والأرباح القوية لشركة Ecopetrol. بيانات السوق ضعيفة قليلاً ونبرة الأخبار أكثر سلبية بقليل من المتوسط العالمي، لذا يقع المؤشر دون اليوم العادي بقليل.
summary.fa: روزی ترکیبی: حملات به پلیس در ووилا و انفجار مرگبار در یک معدن، گزارش‌های کاهش قتل و سودآوری قوی Ecopetrol را تحت‌الشعاع قرار می‌دهد. داده‌های بازار کمی ضعیف‌اند و لحن اخبار اندکی منفی‌تر از میانگین جهانی است، بنابراین امتیاز کمی پایین‌تر از یک روز عادی قرار دارد.

summary.en: The UN biodiversity conference COP17 has opened in Armenia, and the country is attracting international attention. However, routine domestic political tensions continue, including the nationalisation of the electricity grid, relations with the EU, opposition-church tensions, and claims of politically motivated dismissals. With no clear crisis or major positive breakthrough, the score remains neutral.

en: Opening of the UN biodiversity conference COP17 in Yerevan
Nationalisation of the electricity grid (ENA) and arbitration dispute
Reports on the possible consequences of withdrawal from the EU
Tension between opposition and government, church and dismissal claims
Uncertainty over the peace agenda with Azerbaijan

summary.en: The period mixes positive economic and diplomatic items (new Air Serbia flights, flower exports, the TRIPP copper deal) with serious political strain. Police detained 14 after searches at an opposition office, an EU rapporteur urged easing pressure on the Church, and an EAEU report warned of a 69% gas price rise if membership were suspended.

en: Police detentions after searches at opposition office in Stepanavan
EAEU report warning of 69% gas price rise if membership suspended
EU rapporteur urging easing of pressure on the Church

summary.en: The period is dominated by economic and political strain: threatened 69% gas price rises and possible EAEU membership suspension, planned power outages, and opposition arrests ahead of Stepanavan elections with vote-buying and electoral-violation allegations. Offsetting positives include TRIPP progress (US stake and Armenian veto rights) and a well-attended tourism festival, so the score sits modestly below an ordinary day.

en: Threatened 69% gas price increase and EAEU suspension costs
Opposition arrests and detentions ahead of Stepanavan elections
Vote-buying and electoral-violation allegations against officials

summary.en: The period is dominated by political tension: CSTO and EAEU membership threats, opposition detentions and house arrests, and allegations of election interference around municipal polls. Positives include Armenia approving the TRIPP route agreement and a 1.5x rise in exports to the EU, but no violence or institutional collapse is reported.

en: CSTO and EAEU membership threats against Armenia
Detentions and house arrests of opposition candidates and supporters
Allegations of unlawful election interference ahead of municipal votes

summary.en: The period mixes routine government activity, such as investment committee approvals, US border-security equipment and the TRIPP transit discussion, with heightened political tension. Tension centres on possible CSTO exit, a snap-election dispute, detentions of opposition supporters and a border incident. GDELT tone (-0.58) is slightly better than the world average, so the net picture is roughly ordinary with a tense political backdrop.

en: Possible CSTO membership decision scheduled for 11 November
Detentions of Samvel Karapetyan supporters and opposition confrontation
US border-security equipment delivery and TRIPP transit debate

en: Opposition candidates and council members detained ahead of local elections

Yerevan's hosting of the UN biodiversity COP17 and positive international coverage add to a mildly positive day, offset by scheduled power cuts and fatal traffic accidents.

en: Local self-government elections held with high turnout

summary.ru: Период сочетает дипломатическую активность (рабочая группа Армения–Россия по железной дороге, визит министра иностранных дел Германии и азербайджанские похвалы в адрес миротворческого руководства) с негативными сюжетами: делом о насильственном преступлении, сообщением о гибели задержанного представителя оппозиции в заключении и дракой в парламенте. Тональность GDELT более негативна, чем среднемировая, однако явного кризиса нет, поэтому оценка немного ниже, чем в обычный день.
summary.ar: تجمع الفترة بين النشاط الدبلوماسي (فريق العمل الأرميني الروسي المعني بالسكك الحديدية، وزيارة وزير الخارجية الألماني، وإشادة أذربيجانية بقيادة تركز على السلام) وأخبار سلبية: قضية جريمة عنيفة، وتقارير عن وفاة معتقل من المعارضة أثناء الاحتجاز، وشجار في البرلمان. نغمة GDELT أكثر سلبية من المتوسط العالمي، لكن لا توجد أزمة واضحة، لذا فإن الدرجة أدنى بقدر معتدل من يوم عادي.
summary.fa: این دوره فعالیت دیپلماتیک (گروه کاری ارمنستان و روسیه درباره راه‌آهن، سفر وزیر خارجه آلمان و تمجید جمهوری آذربایجان از رهبری صلح‌محور) را با اخبار منفی درهم می‌آمیزد: پرونده یک جرم خشونت‌آمیز، گزارش مرگ یکی از بازداشتیان اپوزیسیون در بازداشت و درگیری در پارلمان. لحن GDELT منفی‌تر از میانگین جهانی است، اما بحران روشنی وجود ندارد، بنابراین امتیاز اندکی پایین‌تر از یک روز عادی قرار دارد.
summary.zh: 该时段既有外交活动（亚美尼亚—俄罗斯铁路工作组、德国外交部长访问以及阿塞拜疆对注重和平的领导层的赞扬），也有负面新闻：一起暴力犯罪案件、一名反对派人士在羁押期间死亡的报道，以及议会发生的一起斗殴。GDELT语调比全球平均水平更为负面，但并无明显危机，因此评分略低于普通的一天。
summary.tr: Dönem, diplomatik faaliyetleri (Ermenistan-Rusya demiryolu çalışma grubu, bir Alman dışişleri bakanının ziyareti ve Azerbaycan'ın barışa yönelik liderliğe övgüsü) olumsuz haberlerle (şiddet içeren bir suç davası, gözaltındaki bir muhalefet üyesinin ölümüne dair bildirilen haber ve bir parlamento kavgası) birleştiriyor. GDELT tonu dünya ortalamasından daha olumsuz, ancak net bir kriz yok; bu nedenle skor sıradan bir günün biraz altında yer alıyor.
summary.es: El periodo combina actividad diplomática (el grupo de trabajo ferroviario Armenia-Rusia, una visita del ministro de Asuntos Exteriores alemán y elogios azerbaiyanos al liderazgo orientado a la paz) con noticias negativas: un caso de delito violento, la supuesta muerte bajo custodia de un detenido de la oposición y una pelea en el parlamento. El tono de GDELT es más negativo que el promedio mundial, pero no hay una crisis clara, por lo que la puntuación se sitúa algo por debajo de un día ordinario.
summary.fr: La période mêle activité diplomatique (le groupe de travail ferroviaire Arménie-Russie, une visite du ministre allemand des Affaires étrangères et les éloges azerbaïdjanais envers une direction orientée vers la paix) et informations négatives : une affaire de crime violent, le décès signalé en détention d'un opposant et une bagarre au parlement. Le ton GDELT est plus négatif que la moyenne mondiale, mais il n'y a pas de crise évidente, si bien que le score se situe modérément en deçà d'une journée ordinaire.
summary.de: Der Zeitraum verbindet diplomatische Aktivitäten (die Arbeitsgruppe zur Eisenbahn Armenien-Russland, ein Besuch des deutschen Außenministers und aserbaidschanisches Lob für eine auf Frieden ausgerichtete Führung) mit negativen Meldungen: einem Fall von Gewaltkriminalität, einem gemeldeten Todesfall eines Oppositionellen in Haft und einer Schlägerei im Parlament. Der GDELT-Tonwert ist negativer als der weltweite Durchschnitt, doch es gibt keine klare Krise, weshalb der Wert leicht unter dem eines gewöhnlichen Tages liegt.
summary.pt: O período combina atividade diplomática (o grupo de trabalho ferroviário Armênia-Rússia, uma visita do chanceler alemão e elogios azerbaijanos à liderança voltada para a paz) com notícias negativas: um caso de crime violento, a suposta morte sob custódia de um detido da oposição e uma briga no parlamento. O tom do GDELT é mais negativo que a média mundial, mas não há uma crise clara, por isso a pontuação fica moderadamente abaixo de um dia comum.
summary.ja: この期間は外交活動(アルメニアとロシアの鉄道作業部会、ドイツ外相の訪問、平和志向の指導部に対するアゼルバイジャンの評価)と、否定的な報道(暴力犯罪事件、野党議員の拘束中の死亡が報じられた件、議会での乱闘)が混在している。GDELTのトーンは世界平均より否定的だが、明確な危機は見られないため、スコアは通常の日より わずかに低い水準にとどまっている。
summary.ko: 이 기간에는 외교 활동(아르메니아-러시아 철도 실무그룹, 독일 외무장관 방문, 평화 지향 지도부에 대한 아제르바이잔의 찬사)과 부정적인 보도(폭력 범죄 사건, 구금 중 야당 인사 사망이 보도된 건, 의회 내 몸싸움)가 뒤섞여 있다. GDELT 톤은 세계 평균보다 부정적이지만 뚜렷한 위기는 없어, 점수는 평범한 하루보다 다소 낮은 수준에 머문다.
summary.hi: इस अवधि में कूटनीतिक गतिविधियाँ (आर्मेनिया-रूस रेलवे कार्य समूह, जर्मन विदेश मंत्री की यात्रा, और शांति-उन्मुख नेतृत्व की अज़रबैजान द्वारा प्रशंसा) और नकारात्मक खबरें (एक हिंसक अपराध मामला, हिरासत में एक विपक्षी सदस्य की मौत की रिपोर्ट, और संसद में मारपीट) दोनों शामिल हैं। GDELT का लहजा विश्व औसत से अधिक नकारात्मक है, लेकिन कोई स्पष्ट संकट नहीं है, इसलिए स्कोर सामान्य दिन से थोड़ा नीचे है।
summary.el: Η περίοδος συνδυάζει διπλωματική δραστηριότητα (η ομάδα εργασίας για τον σιδηρόδρομο Αρμενίας-Ρωσίας, η επίσκεψη του Γερμανού υπουργού Εξωτερικών και ο έπαινος του Αζερμπαϊτζάν για την ηγεσία με προσανατολισμό στην ειρήνη) με αρνητικές ειδήσεις: μια υπόθεση βίαιου εγκλήματος, αναφορά για θάνατο μέλους της αντιπολίτευσης υπό κράτηση και καυγά στο κοινοβούλιο. Ο τόνος του GDELT είναι αρνητικότερος από τον παγκόσμιο μέσο όρο, ωστόσο δεν υπάρχει σαφής κρίση, οπότε το σκορ βρίσκεται μετρίως κάτω από μια συνηθισμένη ημέρα.

summary.en: War continues in Sudan. Drone attacks in Kordofan, Darfur, Khartoum and Abyei killed more than 100 civilians within 24 hours, including three children. A record parallel-market dollar rate and an increase in the customs dollar rate are deepening the economic collapse; the UN condemned the attacks.

Das Abkommen zwischen Contact Energy und Rio Tinto ermöglicht den Neustart der Potline in Tiwai Point

O acordo Contact Energy-Rio Tinto permite a reabertura da potline de Tiwai Point

summary.en: Indonesia is experiencing its worst forest fire season since 2015. The fires have burned about two million hectares, smoke has spread, and 2,600 flights were disrupted. The stock market fell 18% in a month, one of its sharpest declines since 1998, and faces a possible MSCI downgrade. Today's 5,65% rebound does not reverse this picture. Protests are also taking place on Prabowo's second anniversary in office, with more than 9.000 security personnel deployed and falling public support.

en: The worst forest fire and smoke crisis since 2015, burning about two million hectares
A record two-day stock market collapse and MSCI pressure; an 18% monthly loss, with a partial rebound today
Protests on Prabowo's second anniversary, heavy security measures and declining public support
Suspension of foreign aid offers for the fires and tensions with neighbouring countries
KPK corruption investigations that also cover BNPB

summary.en: Indonesia faces several serious pressures at once: student protests over living costs and forest fires, a worsening haze crisis with Singapore's enforcement action, and a sharp equity sell-off (down about 11% in a week) tied to MSCI classification concerns. Positive items such as EU drought aid and a rediscovered primate are minor by comparison.

en: Student protests over living costs and fires; 9,505 security personnel deployed
Haze crisis: Singapore expands crackdown; 2,600+ flights disrupted
IDX down 10.78% week and 16.95% month amid MSCI dispute

summary.en: Indonesia faces a stock market rout of about 14% over a month after an MSCI downgrade threat, student protests over living costs and forest fires, fuel and power shortages in parts of the country, and a ferry fire. Partial offsets include a one-day market rebound, Danantara's plan to deploy capital, and improving fuel supply in Bali.

en: Student protests over living costs and forest fires spread nationwide
Market rout after MSCI downgrade threat; Prabowo rejects intimidation
Forest fire haze causing health harm; fuel and power shortages in Kaltim

summary.en: The period is dominated by a widening haze crisis that has disrupted thousands of flights, plus an MSCI downgrade risk that has pushed the IDX down about 15% over the month. Partial offsets include a one-week stock rebound, a $22.94B investment expo tally and routine economic and investment news.

en: Widening haze crisis; thousands of flights affected
MSCI downgrade risk and a 14.7% monthly fall in the IDX
Gas export halt debate and regional tensions ahead of ASEAN summit

summary.en: The period is mostly routine local news, but a severe haze crisis is sparking student protests and fires in Papua and South Sumatra. Gas export cuts to Singapore and an MSCI-related market concern add economic strain, though the stock index rebounded over the past week and the overall tone is not strongly negative.

en: Worst haze in over a decade sparks student protests
Gas exports to Singapore cut to prioritise domestic demand
MSCI report criticised by minister; index down 14.7% in a month

summary.en: Indonesia's period is dominated by a worsening haze crisis, with student and public protests, a cut in gas exports to Singapore, and drought warnings from El Nino. Market stress is also visible after the MSCI announcement, though the stock index rose over the past day and week, and most other coverage is routine.

en: Haze crisis triggers protests and tourism cancellations across the region
Gas export cut to Singapore prioritises domestic demand
MSCI announcement stirs market stress; authorities moving to stabilise

summary.en: Mixed day: wildfire hotspots fell by more than half and the stock index rebounded over the week, but the index is down 14% over the month after an MSCI-triggered rout, and a gas export dispute with Singapore and haze costs weigh on the outlook. A deadly clash in Bandung and an ongoing corruption trial add to the negatives, so the picture is close to an ordinary period.

en: Fire hotspots fell by more than half to 147
IDX down 14% over the month after MSCI-triggered rout
Gas export cuts to Singapore spark diplomatic friction

summary.en: The period mixes routine local news with several serious stresses: the IDX fell 2.48% on the day and 16% over the month, the rupiah weakened to 18,140 per dollar, and wildfire haze is hitting Sumatra and Kalimantan. A diplomatic row with Singapore over gas exports and haze, plus concerns about rule of law, add to the pressure, though first rains are bringing some relief.

en: IDX down 16% over the month and 2.48% on the day
Rupiah weakened to 18,140 per US dollar
Wildfire haze crisis; first rains bring partial relief

summary.en: The period is mostly routine: Youth Pledge commemorations, investment announcements such as a US$500 million Batam semiconductor project, and a Singapore-Indonesia haze task force. Offsetting this are a diplomatic spat with Singapore, student protests in Jakarta, and a 14% monthly fall in the stock index.

en: Singapore-Indonesia spat over haze, gas and internet cable threats
Student demonstrations in Jakarta and detention of a student union head
Joint haze task force and US$500M Batam semiconductor project

summary.en: Indonesia faces large student and public protests over haze, wildfires, graft and living costs, with security forces being deployed in advance. The IDX fell 3.49% on the day and 16.72% over the month, signalling market stress, though bilateral haze agreements and a landmark ruling on civilian trials of soldiers offset some of the negatives.

en: Large protests over haze, graft and living costs; security buildup
IDX down 16.72% over one month and 3.49% in one day
Singapore-Indonesia agreements on haze and energy cooperation

summary.en: The 24-hour news flow is mostly routine local coverage, but it is dominated by serious strains: the IDX has fallen 16.7% over a month amid MSCI concerns, rupiah pressure is noted, and a wildfire-haze crisis is linked to a study estimating 3,560 deaths. A Yogyakarta unrest episode with 116 victims adds to the strain, partly offset by growth and infrastructure items.

en: IDX down 16.7% in a month, MSCI concerns weighing on investors
Study links September wildfire smoke to 3,560 deaths
20 companies named as suspects in forest fire crackdown

summary.en: Indonesia's period is dominated by serious problems: a deadly fire-haze crisis with reports of over 3,000 deaths, floods in North Sumatra, and a sharp stock market slide (down 16.7% over a month). Partial offsets include Eni's gas production start and routine government and business news, but the overall picture is clearly negative.

en: Fire pollution reportedly killed over 3,000 people in September
IDX down 16.7% in a month and 7% in a week
Haze and wildfires across five provinces; floods in North Sumatra

summary.en: The period is mostly routine: domestic media report investment milestones and ordinary policy news, and rains are reported to be easing the wildfire crisis. Offsetting this, the IDX has fallen 16.7% over a month and foreign outlets report smog linked to thousands of deaths.

en: IDX down 16.7% over one month and 7% over one week
Wildfire smog and reported deaths, though hotspots fell to 96
Rains arriving to ease fire crisis; domestic investment reported at Rp2,000 trillion

summary.en: The period mixes routine news with several concerns: the IDX fell about 15.6% over the month, MSCI warned about the economy, and student protests are gaining momentum with little government response. A court ruling against the vice president's school certificate and a fatal landslide add to the strain, partly offset by investment announcements and falling wildfire hotspots.

en: IDX down 15.57% over one month and 5.14% over one week
Student protests gaining momentum with little government response
Supreme Court annulled vice president's high school certificate

summary.en: The period combines serious stress signals: the IDX fell 3.78% in a day and 18.76% over a month, with an MSCI warning, and wildfires have scorched 1.9 million hectares, causing regional haze frustration. Floods and a landslide added humanitarian strain, partly offset by routine gas supply and manufacturing investment news.

en: IDX down 3.78% in one day, 18.76% in a month
Wildfires scorch 1.9 million hectares; regional haze frustration
MSCI warning on Indonesia's market standing

summary.en: Indonesia's period is dominated by a serious institutional crisis: three police generals, including a former police chief, were detained over an alleged wiretap of President Prabowo, and over 20,000 troops were deployed to Jakarta. Markets are under strain, with the IDX down 19.6% over a month and rupiah weakness concerns, though manufacturing PMI hit a strong 54.0 and export orders rose.

en: Generals detained over alleged wiretapping of the president
Over 20,000 troops deployed to Jakarta amid probe
IDX down 19.6% in a month; rupiah pressure concerns

summary.en: Indonesia's period is dominated by a wiretapping scandal involving generals' arrests and a heavy troop deployment in Jakarta, with foreign media reporting high tension. Compounding this, the most intense wildfires in 11 years are spreading across several islands, and the stock index is down about 19% over the month, though routine governance and trade news continued.

en: Thousands of troops deployed in Jakarta after generals' arrests over wiretapping
Most intense wildfires in 11 years across Sumatra, Borneo and Papua
IDX down 18.77% over one month despite a one-day rebound

summary.en: The period mixes routine governance and positive economic news (Q3 GDP at 5.47%, Alibaba Cloud's second data center) with stress signals: a wiretapping scandal involving the president, a rift between Prabowo and Jokowi, Borneo forest fires needing foreign aid, and a 17.8% monthly fall in the IDX. On balance this is a near-ordinary day with a slightly negative lean.

en: Presidential wiretapping scandal and the resulting political rupture
Q3 GDP growth of 5.47% and strong East Java growth
Forest fires in Borneo with Australian military support

summary.en: The period mixes positive economic news (5.87% manufacturing growth, new investment commitments, falling brawl cases) with negative stories: protests over data centres and a wiretap scandal, a helicopter crash with a missing crew member, and haze-related health and fire problems. The IDX fell 17.84% over the month, though it was flat over the week, so the day is roughly ordinary with some strain.

en: Manufacturing output grew 5.87%, led by furniture
Data-centre water shortage protests and wiretap scandal coverage
Haze: over 400,000 respiratory infections; fires still active

summary.en: The day mixes routine news with some negatives: a firefighting helicopter crash that killed a crew member amid wildfires and haze, and a mosque attack whose suspect has been named. Foreign investment commitments and a mild one-day stock gain offset this, though the one-month fall of about 17% in the index is a notable concern.

en: Firefighting helicopter crash kills crew member amid wildfires
Investment commitments of $138m from Europe and $385m from the UK
IDX down about 17% over the past month

summary.en: The period mixes routine Hero's Day coverage with several serious problems: a wildfire haze crisis with over 400,000 respiratory cases, fatal firefighting helicopter crashes, a wave of cyberattacks on banks, and flooding in Aceh and Bali. The Vice President's reported intent to step down adds political strain, though the stock market rebounded over the week and GDELT tone is slightly positive.

en: Wildfire haze causing over 400,000 respiratory illness cases
Fatal helicopter crashes during Kalimantan firefighting operations
Surge in cyberattacks on Indonesian banks

summary.en: The period mixes routine positive news (OECD reform pace, ICAO aviation oversight, IDX investor outreach) with serious political and public-order strain. Violent protests led to mass detentions, and the Vice President's resignation offer amid eligibility questions and impeachment calls adds institutional pressure, while the IDX is down about 14% over the month.

en: Violent protests followed by 154 detentions
Vice President offers resignation amid impeachment calls
Wiretap scandal raising political tension

summary.en: Vice-President Gibran formally submitted his resignation to parliament amid an education-credentials controversy, following 120 lawmakers seeking impeachment, and foreign outlets report protests with dozens detained and falling presidential approval. Local news is otherwise routine, and institutions are functioning through the formal resignation process, with the stock index rebounding 2.66% on the day.

en: Vice-President's resignation over credential controversy and destabilising political feud
Protests with dozens detained; presidential approval reportedly collapsing
Impeachment push by 120 lawmakers; wiretapping allegations against the president

summary.en: The Vice President's resignation amid a credentials dispute and reported coalition cracks is a significant political shock, though the constitutional succession process (MPR session, December 2 upper-house vote) is proceeding in an orderly way. Allegations of excessive force against protesters add strain, while the stock market rebounded over the week and routine economic and social news was steady.

en: Vice President Gibran resigns over diploma and eligibility disputes
MPR to convene on the vacancy; successor vote set for December 2
Allegations of excessive force against protesters

summary.en: The period is dominated by the vice president's resignation, reported alongside protests, a wiretapping scandal and worker protests over cuts to a free meal programme. Domestic media is mostly routine, and the stock market rebounded over the week, so the score sits in the low-40s rather than the serious-problems band.

en: Vice President Gibran resigns; successor vote set for December 2
Reports of protests and police intimidation of churches
Wiretapping scandal opens political fault line

summary.en: The period mixes a vice-presidential resignation and succession jockeying with protests, floods and tremors, which points to political strain. Markets rebounded over the week and the government targeted 5.45% growth, so the picture is not a clear crisis.

en: Vice president resigned; succession contest over Dasco and Gibran's successor
Protest movement issuing five demands against oligarchy and wiretapping
Subulussalam flooding damaged schools, clinics and water intake

summary.en: The period is mostly routine domestic news, with the IDX up 4.87% over the week and a less negative media tone than the world average. Against that, the haze apology to neighbours, HRW allegations of excessive force against protesters, and a wiretapping scandal weigh on the score.

en: Presidential apology to Singapore and Malaysia over wildfire haze
HRW allegations of excessive force against protesters
Wiretapping scandal opening a political fault line

summary.en: The period mixes serious stress with routine news: a M7.1 earthquake in Maluku, reports of growing student protests, the worst forest fires in 11 years with a haze apology, and corruption probes. Offsetting this are a 3.5% weekly gain in the IDX and positive trade and ASEAN digital-payment headlines, so the score sits somewhat below an ordinary day.
summary.ja: 今期は深刻な懸念と日常的なニュースが混在しています。マルク諸島でのM7.1の地震、学生抗議の拡大に関する報道、11年ぶりの最悪の森林火災と近隣国へのヘイズ(煙害)謝罪、そして汚職捜査です。一方で、IDXの週間3.5%上昇や、貿易およびASEANのデジタル決済に関する前向きな見出しが相殺要因となり、スコアは通常の日よりやや低い水準にとどまっています。
summary.ko: 이번 기간에는 심각한 우려와 일상적인 뉴스가 뒤섞여 있습니다. 말루쿠에서 규모 7.1의 지진이 발생했고, 학생 시위 확산에 대한 보도, 11년 만에 최악의 산불과 이웃 국가에 대한 연무(헤이즈) 사과, 그리고 부패 수사가 이어졌습니다. 반면 IDX의 주간 3.5% 상승과 무역 및 ASEAN 디지털 결제 관련 긍정적 헤드라인이 이를 일부 상쇄하여, 점수는 평범한 날보다 다소 낮은 수준에 머물러 있습니다.
summary.hi: इस अवधि में गंभीर तनाव और नियमित समाचार दोनों शामिल हैं: मालुकु में M7.1 का भूकंप, छात्र विरोध प्रदर्शनों के बढ़ने की रिपोर्टें, 11 वर्षों में सबसे भीषण वन अग्निकांड और धुंध (हेज़) के लिए माफ़ी, तथा भ्रष्टाचार जांच। इसके विपरीत, IDX में 3.5% की साप्ताहिक बढ़त और व्यापार तथा ASEAN डिजिटल भुगतान से जुड़ी सकारात्मक सुर्खियाँ इसे संतुलित करती हैं, इसलिए स्कोर एक सामान्य दिन से कुछ नीचे रहता है।
summary.el: Η περίοδος συνδυάζει σοβαρή πίεση με συνηθισμένες ειδήσεις: σεισμός 7,1 Richter στα Μολούκκα, αναφορές για αυξανόμενες φοιτητικές διαμαρτυρίες, οι χειρότερες δασικές πυρκαγιές των τελευταίων 11 ετών με συγγνώμη για την ομίχλη καπνού, και έρευνες για διαφθορά. Αντίβαρο αποτελούν η εβδομαδιαία άνοδος 3,5% του IDX και θετικοί τίτλοι για το εμπόριο και τις ψηφιακές πληρωμές της ASEAN, γι' αυτό η βαθμολογία βρίσκεται κάπως κάτω από μια συνηθισμένη ημέρα.
summary.it: Il periodo unisce forte tensione e notizie di routine: un terremoto di magnitudo 7.1 nelle Molucche, segnalazioni di proteste studentesche in crescita, i peggiori incendi boschivi degli ultimi 11 anni con le scuse per la foschia e inchieste per corruzione. A compensare ci sono un aumento settimanale del 3,5% dell'IDX e notizie positive su commercio e pagamenti digitali nell'ASEAN, quindi il punteggio si colloca leggermente al di sotto di una giornata ordinaria.
summary.ru: Период сочетает серьёзное напряжение с обычными новостями: землетрясение магнитудой 7,1 на Молуккских островах, сообщения о growing студенческих протестах, худшие за 11 лет лесные пожары с извинениями за смог и расследования коррупции. Компенсируют это рост IDX за неделю на 3,5% и позитивные новости о торговле и цифровых платежах АСЕАН, поэтому оценка немного ниже, чем в обычный день.
summary.ar: تجمع الفترة بين ضغوط جدية وأخبار روتينية: زلزال بقوة 7.1 درجة في جزر مالوكو، وتقارير عن تزايد الاحتجاجات الطلابية، وأسوأ حرائق غابات منذ 11 عامًا مع اعتذار عن الضباب الدخاني، وتحقيقات في قضايا فساد. ويقابل ذلك ارتفاع مؤشر IDX بنسبة 3.5% خلال الأسبوع وأخبار إيجابية عن التجارة والمدفوعات الرقمية في رابطة الآسيان، لذلك تقع النتيجة أدنى قليلًا من يوم عادي.
summary.fa: این دوره ترکیبی از فشار جدی و اخبار روزمره است: زمین‌لرزه‌ای ۷.۱ ریشتری در مالوکو، گزارش‌هایی از افزایش اعتراضات دانشجویی، بدترین آتش‌سوزی‌های جنگلی در ۱۱ سال گذشته همراه با عذرخواهی بابت دود، و تحقیقات فساد. در مقابل، افزایش ۳.۵ درصدی شاخص IDX در هفته و خبرهای مثبت درباره تجارت و پرداخت‌های دیجیتال آسه‌آن قرار دارد، بنابراین امتیاز کمی پایین‌تر از یک روز معمولی است.
summary.zh: 这一时期既有严峻压力，也有常规新闻：马鲁古发生7.1级地震，学生抗议活动增多的报道，11年来最严重的森林火灾并就烟霾致歉，以及腐败调查。与之相抵的是印尼综合股价指数（IDX）周涨3.5%，以及东盟贸易和数字支付的正面消息，因此评分略低于普通的一天。
summary.tr: Dönem ciddi gerilimle olağan haberleri bir arada sunuyor: Maluku'da M7,1 büyüklüğünde bir deprem, artan öğrenci protestolarına dair haberler, 11 yılın en kötü orman yangınları ve duman nedeniyle özür, ayrıca yolsuzluk soruşturmaları. Bunu dengeleyen unsurlar ise IDX'te haftalık %3,5'lik kazanç ile olumlu ticaret ve ASEAN dijital ödeme başlıkları; bu nedenle skor olağan bir günün biraz altında kalıyor.
summary.es: El periodo combina un estrés serio con noticias rutinarias: un terremoto de magnitud 7,1 en Maluku, informes de protestas estudiantiles crecientes, los peores incendios forestales en 11 años con una disculpa por la neblina y investigaciones por corrupción. Compensan este panorama una subida semanal del 3,5 % en el IDX y titulares positivos sobre comercio y pagos digitales de la ASEAN, por lo que la puntuación queda algo por debajo de un día ordinario.
summary.fr: La période mêle un stress sérieux à des informations courantes : un séisme de magnitude 7,1 à Maluku, des informations faisant état de manifestations étudiantes croissantes, les pires incendies de forêt depuis 11 ans accompagnés d'excuses pour la brume, et des enquêtes pour corruption. Ce tableau est atténué par une hausse hebdomadaire de 3,5 % de l'IDX et par des titres positifs sur le commerce et les paiements numériques de l'ASEAN, si bien que le score se situe un peu en dessous d'une journée ordinaire.
summary.de: Der Zeitraum verbindet ernste Belastungen mit alltäglichen Nachrichten: ein Erdbeben der Stärke 7,1 auf den Molukken, Berichte über wachsende Studentenproteste, die schlimmsten Waldbrände seit 11 Jahren mit einer Entschuldigung wegen des Dunstes sowie Korruptionsermittlungen. Dem gegenüber stehen ein wöchentlicher Anstieg des IDX um 3,5 % und positive Schlagzeilen zu Handel und digitalen Zahlungen in der ASEAN, sodass der Wert etwas unter dem eines gewöhnlichen Tages liegt.
summary.pt: O período combina forte tensão com notícias rotineiras: um terremoto de magnitude 7,1 em Maluku, relatos de protestos estudantis crescentes, os piores incêndios florestais em 11 anos com um pedido de desculpas pela névoa e investigações de corrupção. Contrabalançam o quadro um ganho semanal de 3,5% no IDX e manchetes positivas sobre comércio e pagamentos digitais na ASEAN, de modo que a pontuação fica um pouco abaixo de um dia comum.

en: M7.1 earthquake in Maluku raises disaster concerns

summary.es: Período mixto: el gobierno de Georgia mantiene un fuerte enfrentamiento con la UE y avanza en la prohibición de un partido de la oposición, que los críticos describen como una consolidación autocrática, mientras las previsiones de inflación aumentaron y la ayuda de EE. UU. se recortó. Las noticias económicas positivas y de cooperación regional (afirmaciones de crecimiento, alianzas en parques eólicos y ferrocarriles, una reunión prevista con el enviado a Rusia) compensan en parte este panorama, y el tono negativo está algo por encima de la media mundial.
summary.fr: Période contrastée : le gouvernement géorgien est en confrontation vive avec l'UE et poursuit une procédure d'interdiction d'un parti d'opposition, que les critiques présentent comme une consolidation autocratique, tandis que les prévisions d'inflation ont été revues à la hausse et que l'aide américaine a été réduite. Des nouvelles économiques et de coopération régionale positives (affirmations de croissance, partenariats dans l'éolien et le ferroviaire, rencontre prévue avec l'émissaire pour la Russie) atténuent en partie ce tableau, et le ton négatif est légèrement supérieur à la moyenne mondiale.
summary.de: Gemischte Phase: Georgiens Regierung befindet sich in einer scharfen Auseinandersetzung mit der EU und betreibt ein Verbot einer Oppositionspartei, was Kritiker als autokratische Machtkonsolidierung bezeichnen, während die Inflationsprognosen stiegen und die US-Hilfen gekürzt wurden. Positive Wirtschafts- und Nachrichten zur regionalen Zusammenarbeit (Wachstumsangaben, Partnerschaften bei Windparks und Bahnstrecken, ein geplantes Treffen mit dem Russland-Gesandten) mildern dies teilweise, und der negative Tenor liegt etwas über dem weltweiten Durchschnitt.

Notícias econômicas positivas e de cooperação regional (alegações de crescimento, parcerias em parques eólicos e ferrovias, um encontro previsto com o enviado à Rússia) compensam em parte, e o tom negativo está um pouco acima da média mundial.
